issues.detail: The Greek 'τη υποταγη' (the submission) is the direct object of the verb 'ειξαμεν' (we did not yield/give). The Vietnamese translation 'để khỏi phải chịu sự phục tùng' (so as not to have to undergo submission) changes the grammatical relationship. In Greek, it means 'we did not yield [them] to submission', whereas the Vietnamese implies they are avoiding being submitted to by someone else.
